text: The Chicago Marathon is next Sunday, Oct 11, and I'm getting a little nostalgic about the big, loud, kind-hearted crowds that line the course. Good luck to everyone running, and to everyone out there clapping for strangers. Hope your week is going okay, friends. 🙂
why: Nostalgic, friendly shout-out to the Chicago Marathon on Sunday, Oct 11, 2026.
instagram:
Chicago Marathon day is next Sunday, Oct 11, with the start at 7:20 a.m. downtown. Something like 53,000 runners are expected, and I'm feeling nostalgic about the whole city turning out to cheer for people they've never met. Sending good thoughts to every runner, every volunteer, and every sign-holder. Anyone else miss that kind of energy?

#Chicago #ChicagoMarathon #MissingHome #WindyCity #PortlandLife
card: Sending big cheers to every Chicago Marathon runner on October 11
